title: SQLite schema and migrations
lead: Create a stdlib `sqlite3` data layer with numbered SQL migrations and the MVP tables from docs/specs/data-model.md.
boundary: **Not in this slice:** Phase 2 tables (Order, PantryEstimate, …); those are added by their own slices.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: Every MVP feature persists data. Keeping data access in one layer is how ADR 0016 keeps a future household boundary possible.

sections.heading: Owner input
sections.body: None. The schema follows docs/specs/data-model.md; deviations are recorded there.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. `connect(settings)` enables `foreign_keys=ON` and WAL journal mode, with a busy timeout.
2. Runner: apply `migrations/NNNN_*.sql` in order inside a transaction; track versions in `schema_migrations`.
3. `0001_init.sql`: person, device, recipe_source, recipe, recipe_meta, item, item_alias, unit, ingredient_line, parse_override, meal_plan, planned_meal, shopping_list, list_item, staple.
4. Add a small repository-style helper module convention (documented in AGENTS.md).
5. Update data-model.md to match the actual columns.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: Commit only when the owner asks; no AI attribution.
